topics.label: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Cardiovascular Outcome Trials
topics.query: ("type 2 diabetes") AND (liraglutide OR semaglutide OR dulaglutide OR exenatide OR albiglutide OR efpeglenatide) AND ("LEADER" OR "SUSTAIN" OR "REWIND" OR "HARMONY" OR "AMPLITUDE-O")

topics.label: SGLT2 Cardiovascular Outcome Trials
topics.query: ("type 2 diabetes") AND (empagliflozin OR canagliflozin OR dapagliflozin OR ertugliflozin OR sotagliflozin) AND ("EMPA-REG" OR "CANVAS" OR "DECLARE" OR "VERTIS" OR "SCORED")

topics.label: ARNI in Heart Failure
topics.query: ("heart failure") AND ("sacubitril valsartan" OR ARNI) AND ("PARADIGM-HF" OR "PARAGON-HF" OR "PIONEER-HF" OR "LIFE")

topics.label: IVUS or OCT Guided PCI
topics.query: (PCI OR coronary stent) AND (IVUS OR OCT OR "intravascular ultrasound" OR "optical coherence tomography") AND ("ULTIMATE" OR "ILUMIEN" OR "OCTOBER" OR "RENOVATE-COMPLEX-PCI")

topics.label: PCSK9 Inhibition in Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease
topics.query: ("cardiovascular disease" OR "acute coronary syndrome" OR coronary) AND (evolocumab OR alirocumab OR inclisiran OR PCSK9) AND ("FOURIER" OR "ODYSSEY" OR "EVOPACS" OR "PACMAN-AMI")

topics.label: GP IIb/IIIa Inhibitors in ACS or PCI
topics.query: (ACS OR PCI OR coronary) AND ("glycoprotein IIb/IIIa" OR tirofiban OR abciximab OR eptifibatide) AND ("EARLY ACS" OR "TARGET" OR "ADVANCE" OR "ON-TIME")

topics.label: Renal Denervation in Hypertension
topics.query: (hypertension OR "blood pressure") AND ("renal denervation" OR "catheter-based renal denervation") AND ("SYMPLICITY" OR "SPYRAL" OR "RADIANCE" OR "TARGET BP")

topics.label: Direct Oral Anticoagulants vs Warfarin in Atrial Fibrillation
topics.query: ("atrial fibrillation") AND (apixaban OR rivaroxaban OR dabigatran OR edoxaban) AND (warfarin OR "vitamin K antagonist") AND ("ARISTOTLE" OR "ROCKET AF" OR "RE-LY" OR "ENGAGE AF")

topics.label: Vericiguat in Heart Failure
topics.query: ("heart failure") AND vericiguat AND ("VICTORIA" OR "SOCRATES")

topics.label: Bivalirudin vs Heparin in ACS or PCI
topics.query: (ACS OR PCI OR coronary) AND (bivalirudin AND heparin) AND ("HORIZONS" OR "EUROMAX" OR "HEAT-PPCI" OR "BRIGHT")

topics.label: Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion vs Anticoagulation
topics.query: ("atrial fibrillation") AND ("left atrial appendage" OR WATCHMAN OR Amulet) AND ("PROTECT-AF" OR "PREVAIL" OR "Amulet IDE" OR "CHAMPION-AF" OR "OPTION")

topics.label: SGLT2 Inhibitors in Heart Failure
topics.query: ("heart failure") AND (dapagliflozin OR empagliflozin OR sotagliflozin OR canagliflozin OR ertugliflozin) AND ("DAPA-HF" OR "DELIVER" OR "EMPEROR" OR "SOLOIST" OR "EMPEROR-Preserved")

topics.label: Catheter Ablation vs Drug Therapy for Atrial Fibrillation
topics.query: ("atrial fibrillation") AND ("catheter ablation") AND ("antiarrhythmic drug" OR "drug therapy" OR medical) AND ("CABANA" OR "EAST-AFNET" OR "STOP AF First" OR "EARLY-AF")

topics.label: FFR or iFR Guided PCI
topics.query: (PCI OR coronary disease) AND (FFR OR iFR OR "fractional flow reserve" OR "instantaneous wave-free") AND ("FAME" OR "DEFINE-FLAIR" OR "iFR-SWEDEHEART" OR "FUTURE")

topics.label: Omecamtiv Mecarbil in Heart Failure
topics.query: ("heart failure") AND ("omecamtiv mecarbil" OR omecamtiv) AND ("GALACTIC-HF" OR "ATOMIC-AHF" OR "COSMIC-HF" OR "METEORIC-HF")

topics.label: Omega-3 Cardiovascular Outcome Trials
topics.query: ("cardiovascular disease" OR diabetes OR hypertriglyceridemia) AND (icosapent OR eicosapentaenoic OR omega-3 OR EPA) AND ("REDUCE-IT" OR "STRENGTH" OR "OMEMI")

topics.label: TAVI/TAVR vs Surgical AVR
topics.query: ("aortic stenosis") AND (TAVR OR TAVI OR "transcatheter aortic valve") AND (surgery OR SAVR OR surgical) AND ("PARTNER" OR "CoreValve" OR "SURTAVI" OR "Evolut" OR "NOTION")

topics.label: Antithrombotic Strategies After TAVI/TAVR
topics.query: ("aortic stenosis" OR TAVI OR TAVR OR "transcatheter aortic valve") AND (anticoagulation OR antiplatelet OR apixaban OR edoxaban OR rivaroxaban) AND ("ATLANTIS" OR "ENVISAGE-TAVI AF" OR "POPular TAVI" OR "GALILEO" OR "ADAPT-TAVR")

topics.label: Cangrelor in PCI
topics.query: (PCI OR coronary intervention) AND cangrelor AND ("CHAMPION" OR "BRIDGE")

topics.label: DOAC Plus Antiplatelet Therapy in AF With PCI or ACS
topics.query: ("atrial fibrillation" AND (PCI OR "acute coronary syndrome")) AND (rivaroxaban OR apixaban OR dabigatran OR edoxaban) AND ("PIONEER AF-PCI" OR "RE-DUAL PCI" OR "AUGUSTUS" OR "ENTRUST-AF PCI")

topics.label: Finerenone Cardiorenal Outcome Trials
topics.query: ("chronic kidney disease" AND "type 2 diabetes") AND finerenone AND ("FIDELIO-DKD" OR "FIGARO-DKD" OR "FINEARTS")

topics.label: Intravenous Iron in Heart Failure
topics.query: ("heart failure") AND ("ferric carboxymaltose" OR "intravenous iron" OR iron) AND ("AFFIRM-AHF" OR "FAIR-HF" OR "CONFIRM-HF" OR "IRONMAN" OR "HEART-FID")

topics.label: Ivabradine in Heart Failure or LV Dysfunction
topics.query: ("heart failure" OR "left ventricular dysfunction") AND ivabradine AND ("SHIFT" OR "BEAUTIFUL" OR "EDIFY")

topics.label: Patent Foramen Ovale Closure vs Medical Therapy
topics.query: ("patent foramen ovale") AND (closure OR device) AND ("RESPECT" OR "REDUCE" OR "CLOSE" OR "DEFENSE-PFO")

topics.label: Thrombus Aspiration in STEMI
topics.query: (STEMI OR myocardial infarction) AND ("thrombus aspiration" OR thrombectomy) AND ("TASTE" OR "TOTAL" OR "TAPAS")

topics.label: Ticagrelor vs Clopidogrel in ACS
topics.query: ("acute coronary syndrome" OR myocardial infarction OR NSTEMI OR STEMI) AND (ticagrelor AND clopidogrel) AND ("PLATO" OR "PHILO" OR "POPular AGE")

topics.label: Ticagrelor vs Prasugrel in ACS
topics.query: ("acute coronary syndrome" OR myocardial infarction OR NSTEMI OR STEMI) AND (ticagrelor AND prasugrel) AND ("ISAR-REACT" OR "PRAGUE" OR "DUBIUS")
